protocol.regularization: lambda=3*Sxx; 75% AoA prior + 25% matched beta; fixed before final runs
protocol.estimator: prefix-only causal matched filters and LS; startup uses AoA; all three events scored
protocol.fusion: retained single common structural Kalman; equal algorithm for all beta methods
protocol.snr_semantics: measured signal/noise power after Hamming range FFT, before four-loop average and DBF
protocol.beta_only_semantics: paired output difference vs true-beta run; only where detected points map uniquely; not total-RMSE subtraction
protocol.merged_beta_semantics: no unique true beta assigned to coherent mixtures; report total displacement RMSE
protocol.generation: same A20 response, N=4, 884.850823 Hz frame stream, ADXL 2 kHz; all scenes at 10 m vertical separation
protocol.no_future_data: no whole-record FFT or zero-phase filter in beta fit; prefix equality checked
